usedFor: Razorpay holds payments and refunds, and Harvest keeps your clients when “New Payment Captured” runs “Create a Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment Captured” in Razorpay, then “Create a Client” in Harvest
bestTemplate.why: A captured payment marks a paying customer, who then exists in Harvest as a client.

watchOut: “New Payment Captured” fires on every captured payment, so a repeat customer can run “Create a Client” again.
